reviews.text: Play here: https://youtu.be/_YyNdHeIbQE Really cool game so far I'm not sure how many players are on it since it just released, but the system itself is a blast I love that you have to kind of commit to a genre to get maximum bang for it, but there's also genre cards that counter as well so if you see someone becoming OP you can start scaling against them. The Effects are neat and I love the concept of boosting one character and optimizing them I do wish there was a bit more time between rounds, but honestly it might be a good thing that it's shorter for when people get used to all the skill cards, but as of right now I'm feeling like I have to read fast or miss out. Very promising though I'm sure the creators will have to fine tune some overpowered builds, but after destroying some (I assume bots) you can't lose by checking this out imo.

4.17更新：现版本有严重影响平衡的bug，攻击、生命、闪避、暴击（法术暴击的福灵剂也是，另外似乎这个的持续时间也有问题）基础属性提升技能等级叠加计算方式出了问题，正常应该是是1级给1点，满级额外给1点，最高5级能拿到5+1=6。现在是1级给1点；2级给2点再加1级的1点=3；3级给3点加2级再加1级3+2+1=6；4级4+3+2+1；5级5+4+3+2+1+1=16点，等级越高加的越离谱，譬如闪避技能1级+3点，从前满级也只是加18%闪避，现在是48%闪避加上各种加成轻易就能达成物理免疫。 除了这4个流派的bug极其影响平衡外，护盾和脆弱流的钢铁之肤和侵蚀诅咒效果也过于强力，每一个同系技能就可以直接增伤/减伤3/6/12点，中期点满12个同系技能就直接增/减伤144点，减伤能挡同时间的绝大多数伤害方式，增伤在配合高频伤害即便是以血量见长的对手也能在几秒钟的时间里击败。除了法术流外其他流派都不配给这俩提鞋的 4.16更新：今天又更新了一个新版本，上个版本是特质碎片难以凑齐，导致游戏体验很差；现版本因为多了3次免费的刷新机会，导致特质碎片极易凑齐，套路成形极快，而且十分稳定，很多时候都极难找到克制办法 在这种高强度的环境下，很多后期强度不够的角色完全沦为下水道，大招流的梅琳娜重回巅峰（无脑选法术流技能，前期大概率能选到叠层技能）。 玩家强度也现在急剧提升，ai再没有以前能狙击玩家的能力了，打ai将会比以前更加无趣 两个版本简直就是在走极端 4.7更新：这版调整了天赋特质的获取方法，变得十分不稳定而且很容易让人恼火，不推荐现在游玩 2.27更新：之前的问题都有大幅改善挺好的，现在发现机器人反而是好东西，就靠虐机器人爽了！高分排位的全是神仙，我这种搞不懂低层机制算法的就只好跟机器人过过招了 初评：挺喜欢这种类型，但玩了一阵感觉全都是机器人。。 有些英雄前期铁坐牢，不太理解这种设计

Don't listen to the negative reviews talking about how much worse the most recent patch has made this game. They're right, but don't listen to them. Alpha League is the perfect game to play with one or more friends after several hours of playing some other, significantly better game, when you need something you can stop thinking about and start laughing at. This game is a cluttered, fast-paced mess with maybe a tenth of the tactical thinking other autobattlers have and the most generic character designs you've seen since whatever the last piece of terrible Chinese shovelware you played was. The balancing is terrible, the latest patch only made the game significantly worse mechanically, and none of it is anything even approaching "good" - but funny? Oh baby, is it funny. At the tail end of your next gaming session, I urge you to load this game up with a friend or two who's willing to take a chance on something stupid, pick any character, and start laughing your ass off at this total cluster ♥♥♥♥ of mechanics while the godawful voice lines written by an AI from 2008 play over your complete flailing inability to understand what's going on. I promise it will be worth your collective times.

Honesty loved this game when it came out, the recent patch made it not worth playing unless you want a complete RNG experience. The new trait system makes you chose shards of a trait and you need to collect X amount of shards to get the actual trait and you get a random selection of 3 when you level. The problem with the system is you can re-roll the same things you just rolled on the level prior that you didn't want and to get re rolls you have to scrap the traits when you level, then you have a chance to re-roll again when you level but you could just roll the same traits you re-rolled in the first place. The devs are really trying to fix the game and fine tune the system but it was fine before. Another note in Ranked you get 20 lp if you get 1st place making it almost impossible to climb and reach the top rank Multiverse defend unless you play 50+ games a day. you will get 40 lp if you get 1st place and there's someone in your game that is 2 ranks ahead of you. Overall great auto battler but i cant recommend it based on the changes they have made recently and they refuse to make Hex manageable, when its available no matter who you are playing if you get Rank 3 you will 99% of the time win the game. When they patch the new trait system or make it more manageable and less RNG based I may come back but until then i wont be coming back to the game.

This game cannot be played as intended.[/quote] [quote][url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AI_slop][b]Warning: AI Slop[/b][/url] The developer used talentless, offensive AI slop for peripheral marketing materials.[/quote] [quote][b][url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Microtransaction]Warning: Microtransaction infested mobile app![/url][/b] This game is infested with a toxic mobile app style cash shop. You will be prompted to and expected to give money to the developers through this cash shop to buy in-game goods so you can play the game.[/quote] "Alpha League HD" is one of thousands of nasty mobile apps infesting the "free" section of Steam, but it's not really free. This looks like a tactical combat RPG game with a gritty sci-fi theme, but none of it matters, it's all RNG and every battle is determined, you guessed it, by who spent the most money in the cash shop. There's only a superficial game here. The game visuals and the game itself are incredibly shallow... think of them as the too-bright, colourful, thin plastic cabinet dress theme on a poker machine at the casino. That's basically what this is. So really, the mobile app "game" is just a veneer, a thin skin wrapped around a nasty, predatory mobile app cash shop. Putting that toxic mobile app monetisation aside... this is a mobile app. I didn't spend thousands on a gaming PC so I could pretend it's an iPhone, and I don't think you did either... this kind of mobile app has no place in your Steam library. As with all mobile scams, you're forced to sign a highly questionable yet legally unenforceable End User License Agreement... for such a relatively low effort, low quality mobile app, this is specifically designed to invalidate your consumer rights and destroy your right to privacy. This agreement includes questionable requirements that may attempt to revoke consumer law protections that gamers expect to have, which is also highly problematic. Developers must learn they are here to serve gamers, not control them. I had my cat walk over the keyboard while the EULA was displaying, which fixed that problem for me. Insultingly, the developer used a bunch of GPT AI slop for the Steam store page and marketing material. AI slop is an insult to gamers everywhere, it's trained on copyrighted material without permission. Worse, if they had no qualms about using it here, there's no telling how much of the rest of this product is also vibe coded or made with AI slop. Now on to pricing and value for gamers. [quote][b][url=https://www.ftc.gov/legal-library/browse/federal-register-notices/16-cfr-part-465-trade-regulation-rule-use-consumer-reviews-testimonials-final-rule]Warning: Review Manipulation![/url][/b] This product features a number of fake positive reviews from accounts known to be in the business of review manipulation/paid reviews. They're all written in either Russian or broken English, appear at almost exactly the same time, very shortly after the product launched on Steam, and the accounts are used consistently to write fake reviews for asset flips and other cash grabs/scams. The "Positive" review score on this should be disregarded due to this blatant, unethical review manipulation. This is done to deceive and scam gamers into paying for a bad product. Due to the 2024 FTC ruling, these fake reviews are a violation of US Federal Law ([i]16 CFR § 465.2, 15 U.S.C. § 45[/i])[/quote] All other issues aside (any of which would disqualify this from being worth your time), this is a game that relies on other players for it to be viable, and because there's not enough players, it's not viable. I can't recommend anyone downloads this, it's basically dead. The use of AI slop is a direct insult to gamers and real, ethical content creators and artists everywhere.
